notes: ClearDesk — a working SaaS for customs clearing agents: full clearance-entry pipeline with guarded status transitions (new → awaiting docs → lodged → customs query → assessed → duty paid → released → delivered → closed), an HS tariff schedule, duty/excise/VAT computation with pro-rata CIF allocation and FX conversion, per-mode document checklists that gate lodging, a disbursement ledger with aging buckets and payments, client statements, dashboard KPIs/reports, global search, keyboard shortcuts, CSV exports and printable duty-computation/entry sheets. Pure static product: index.html runs directly from file:// or any static host with zero install; data persists in localStorage (every access wrapped in try/catch with an in-memory fallback and warning banner). Auth is local (salted SHA-256), seed data is generated relative to the current date, and the domain-logic test suite can be run from Settings → Diagnostics (also 'node assets/core.test.js'). Demo credentials are shown on the sign-in screen: clara.otien@atlasfreight.app / demo1234 (manager) and james.mwangi@atlasfreight.app / demo1234 (clerk). Known limitations: single-browser storage, illustrative tariff rates, no real customs-authority or payment integration, local-only auth.
